name: @avatark/living-systems-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral, franchise-neutral, world-neutral contracts for persistent Living World state: WorldClock, SeasonDefinition/SeasonState, EnvironmentalState (weather/hydrology/ecology), LivingEntityState, EncounterRule/AvailableEncounter, ProtectedNarrativeProjection, VisitorWorldMemory, WorldSnapshot, deterministic variation, and repository interfaces. No implementations, no storage, no React, no renderer, zero franchise content.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/environmentalBand.test.ts src/variation.test.ts src/snapshot.test.ts src/protectedNarrative.test.ts src/visitorMemory.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
